title: Film feature vectors
prompt: A recommendation model describes each film by its genre and length. Write `solve(movies)` so it returns `movie_id` and `features`: the one-hot encoded `primary_genre` followed by the runtime, as an array of doubles.
rules: Number the genres most common first, ties alphabetically, and one-hot encode them with the last genre left as all zeros (`OneHotEncoder`'s default).
The runtime comes after the genre values. A film with a missing `runtime_min` gets the mean of the known runtimes, not rounded.
Return `movie_id` and `features` (an array of doubles), in that order. Keep every film.
hints: `StringIndexer`, then `OneHotEncoder`, then `VectorAssembler` with `inputCols` in the order the values should appear. A `Pipeline` can run them in one `fit`.
`Imputer` keeps the column's type. Cast `runtime_min` to double first, or the mean is cut to a whole number.
`vector_to_array` from `pyspark.ml.functions` turns the assembled vector into an array column.
